Complete Level-4 and A-Inheritance task types
commitResults.messageBody: Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses and parse their respective commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-5 and A-Exceptions error handling
commitResults.messageBody: Add KayaException and handle invalid commands, malformed task details, invalid task numbers, and task capacity errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Level-6 and A-Collections task deletion
commitResults.messageBody: Add the delete command and replace the fixed task array with an ArrayList-backed List.
Add CommandType and use enum-based command dispatch instead of repeated string comparisons.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add persistent storage for tasks Save task-list changes automatically and restore saved tasks on startup. Handle missing storage files, directories, and malformed records safely.

commitResults.messageBody: Parse task dates using LocalDate, display it in a readable format and safely handle legacy stored dates
Separate user interaction, command parsing, task-list management, storage, and application coordination into focused classes.
Group commands, parsing, storage, tasks, UI, and exceptions by responsibility while keeping src/main/java as the source root.
